dc to vc, 2026-11-26 14:41Z by date -u: both answers, read from devbin's code at fc9f72ae and Intent's tree at 5fdb5f1f2. Nothing was run, and kovacs was not read. 1. For intent-vc. Answer: devbin 0.1.34's notary change does not reach Intent's cut, and by read Intent's cut never needed the unlocked session for its credentials. - What 0.1.34 changed: devbin's built-in lib/cmd/macos gives every notarytool call `--keychain --keychain-profile ` through notary_auth (lib/cmd/macos:285-294): the submit (:407-410), doctor's history query (:1409-1410) and store-creds (:1423-1430). At 0.1.33, --keychain-profile alone read the data-protection keychain, which a screen lock makes unreadable. That stopped Gtools' cut on 25 Nov. - Intent does not run that code. Its macOS stage runs Intent's own handler, bin/.devbin/cmd/macos (Intent's bin/.devbin/config.yaml:476-484). The handler reads three generic-password items, intent.apple.APPLE_ID, APPLE_APP_PASSWORD and APPLE_TEAM_ID, with `security find-generic-password` (cmd/macos:71, :145-149). Its store-creds writes them with `security add-generic-password` (:1731), so they are in the login keychain file. The submit passes --apple-id, --password and --team-id (:733-735, :2367). No notarytool profile and no data-protection keychain is in that path. - The dry run: devbin's pre-flight runs `macos doctor` through the launcher, in a dry run as in a cut (lib/cmd/release:3149-3163; pre-flight has no dry-run guard). In Intent that is Intent's doctor: the three items' presence (cmd/macos:607-612) and a test-sign with --timestamp (:590-600). It makes no notarytool call and submits nothing (lib/cmd/release:82-83). - Measured or read: READ for Intent. What was measured is the keychain file: I7679181's live proof (rhadamanth, 2026-11-26 05:46Z, in that issue's Resolution) read from the login keychain file and test-signed with the Developer ID key during a 30-second display-dim lock, and both passed. Intent's own `security` reads and its submit under a lock were not measured. - One check that would measure it: in Intent's checkout, start `bin/devbin macos doctor` from a timer, lock the screen before it fires, and read its output for the three items PRESENT and "signs and verifies". It submits nothing to Apple. Not run. - For any cut: a system sleep stops the run whatever the keychain does (decision 317's resume ran under caffeinate -d). A login keychain set to lock on sleep or after an idle time locks the file too; `security show-keychain-info` reads that setting. Not run. 2. For kovacs-sysadm. The leg runner's paths, lib/release.legs, for

= devbin and intent (their project.name: devbin's bin/.devbin/config.yaml:13, Intent's :7): - KEEP ~/work/

-leg.git, the bare repo (:168-182). Removing it is safe, but the next start makes it again and sends the whole history (:599). Never remove it while a worktree of it exists. - SAFE, no cost: ~/work/

-leg- with .rc beside it, and its .log, .tmp, .rc and .rc.part. That is an ended run. The runner clears it itself after it copies the log back (_release_leg_finish, :496-504, through _release_leg_remote_clear, :398-420), and at the next start for any other commit (_release_leg_clear_ended, :524, called at :593). Remove it the runner's way: `git -C ~/work/

-leg.git worktree remove --force `; `chmod -R u+w .tmp` then `rm -rf .tmp`; `rm -f .log .rc .rc.part`; `git -C ~/work/

-leg.git update-ref -d refs/devbin/legs/`. A log never copied back is the only copy (:493), so keep the .log files if in doubt. They are small. - SAFE, remove first: ~/work/

-leg- with NO .rc beside it, when no leg process runs on kovacs. That is a run killed before it wrote its status. The runner never clears it (:385). While it stays, every start of

skips the cache bound (:274-284), so ~/work/

-leg.cache grows past its bound. Same steps. Cost: none, unless a cut at that sha is still open; its resume then runs the leg again. - SAFE, with a cost: ~/work/

-leg.cache, the gates' DEVBIN_GATE_CACHE (:260, :335), eg Intent's cargo target. Only when no leg of

runs, and `chmod -R u+w` first, as gate_cache_bound does (:193). Cost: the next leg of

builds cold, a full cargo build for Intent. The runner empties it itself at a start once it is over release.gate_cache.max (:284). - Finding: release.gate_cache.max is 12G by default (lib/config.reference.yaml:654-655), and neither devbin nor Intent sets its own. One project's cache can fill kovacs's 12G free before its bound empties it. A smaller bound in each project's config fixes that; it is each project's config, for its vc. - Order: check that no leg runs (no `bin/devbin release gates` process under ~/work); remove the killed runs, then the ended runs; read `du -sh ~/work/*` again; remove a .cache only if still short, Intent's last. Intent's log has a 3.5.6 GO at 14:34Z, and a removed cache makes its next kovacs leg cold. kovacs-sysadm's du says which of these holds the 15G.
